## Conclusions
- **The fine-tuned B (exp 010) is a valid submission:** 14.41 + 3.27 = **17.68 ms** on the Galaxy S22 (QNN), the
  same as pretrained B in exp 004 (17.70 ms). Fine-tuning changes only the weights, as expected.
- **The device matches PyTorch:** device frac R@10 on the LPCVC sample is 91.37, identical to the local value, and
  the minimum embedding cosine is 0.9999 (image) / 1.0000 (text). The QNN float path does not lose any of the fine-tuning gain.
- **This is now our best valid model:** 87.34 on RefCOCOg-LPCVC (official baseline 63.19), 91.37 on the sample
  (baseline 87.35), at 17.7 ms (budget 35 ms).
- `aihub_run.py` now sanitizes model names into folder tags (`safe_tag`), so checkpoint names
  (`model#path~alpha`) work for export and job names.
